title: SWF: DoAction frame scripts
description: Ensure frame scripts (frame.script !== '') are compiled to AS2 bytecode and emitted as DoAction (tag 12) before ShowFrame for each frame. Read packages/swf/src/compile.ts to check if DoAction is currently emitted. If the AS2 compiler (packages/core/src/as2/compiler.ts) is used correctly via compileAS2. Wire it: for each frame in the frame loop, if frame.script is non-empty compile it and emit DoAction(tag 12) body = AS2 bytes. Add unit tests.
